title: Main Bayaan Kaise Karu Meri Musibat Amma
body:
Main Bayaan Kaise Karu Meri Musibat Amma
uthke Zainab (sa) Ki Zara Dekhlo Gurbat Amma
1. Lutke Pardes Se Aayi Hoon Mai Amma Utho
mujhpe Jo Guzri Hai Rudaad Sitam Ki Pucho
har Qadam Maine Uthaayi Hai Aziyat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jeete Ji Bhai Ke Gham Ne Mujhe Maara Dekho
dedo Beti Ko Tumhaari Ye Sahaara Dedo
khogayi Aankho'n Se Meri Ye Basaarat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dar Badar Kucha O Bazaar Phiraaya Humko
taaziyano'n Se Layeeno'n Ne Rulaaya Humko
zulm Karti Rahi Nana Ki Ye Ummat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mere Majaaye Ko Teero'n Pe Tadapte Dekha
garm Rethi Pa Use Sar Ko Patakte Dekha aur Layee'n Naizo Se Dete The Aziyat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kund Khanjar Liye Zalim Jo Chada Seene Par
main Tadapti Rahi Chillati Rahi Ro Ro Kar
ek Bahen Se Suno Bhai Ki Shahadat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bhai Ka Lasha Mere Is Tarah Pamaal Hua
ungliyaa'n Kat Gayi Mithi Pa Kaleja Dekha
main Bayaa'n Kaise Karu Ab Nahi Himmat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mere Abid (as) Ko Pinhaayi Gayi Bhaari Bedi
mujhse Dekhi Nahi Jaati Thi Wo Gurbat Uski
main Bacha Laayi Hoon Sholo'n Se Imamat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mera Qasim (as) Nahi Abbas E Dilawar Bhi Nahi
margaye Aon O Mohd (as) Mera Akbar (as) Bhi Nahi
main Bana Aayi Hoon Har Ek Ki Turbat Amma
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Tum Azadaare Shahe Dee'n Ko Duayei'n Dena
apne Rumaal Me Le Lena Har Ek Ashk E Aza
Kazmi
Ne Hai Likhi Meri Musibat Amma
